<assembly xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-assembly-plugin/assembly/1.1.2"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
          xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-assembly-plugin/assembly/1.1.2 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/assembly-1.1.2.xsd">
  <id>xplan-distribution</id>
  <formats>
    <format>zip</format>
  </formats>
  <includeBaseDirectory>false</includeBaseDirectory>

  <dependencySets>
    <dependencySet>
      <useProjectArtifact>false</useProjectArtifact>
      <outputDirectory>doc</outputDirectory>
      <outputFileNameMapping>${artifact.artifactId}${dashClassifier?}.${artifact.extension}</outputFileNameMapping>
      <includes>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-benutzerhandbuch:*:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-betriebshandbuch:*:*</include>
      </includes>
    </dependencySet>
    <dependencySet>
      <useProjectArtifact>false</useProjectArtifact>
      <outputDirectory>bin</outputDirectory>
      <outputFileNameMapping>${artifact.artifactId}${dashClassifier?}.${artifact.extension}</outputFileNameMapping>
      <includes>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-cli:zip:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-validator-executor:jar:*</include>
      </includes>
    </dependencySet>
    <dependencySet>
      <useProjectArtifact>false</useProjectArtifact>
      <outputDirectory>web</outputDirectory>
      <outputFileNameMapping>${artifact.artifactId}${dashClassifier?}.${artifact.extension}</outputFileNameMapping>
      <includes>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-manager-web:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-manager-api:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-webpages:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-validator-web:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-validator-api:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-dokumente-api:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-services-wfs-syn:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-services-wfs:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-services-wms:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-webservices-inspireplu:war:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-webservices-validator-wms:war:*</include>
      </includes>
    </dependencySet>
    <dependencySet>
      <useProjectArtifact>false</useProjectArtifact>
      <outputDirectory>conf</outputDirectory>
      <outputFileNameMapping>${artifact.artifactId}${dashClassifier?}.${artifact.extension}</outputFileNameMapping>
      <includes>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-manager-config:zip:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-validator-config:zip:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-dokumente-config:zip:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-mapserver-config:zip:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-mapproxy-config:zip:*</include>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-ldproxy-config:zip:*</include>
      </includes>
    </dependencySet>
    <dependencySet>
      <useProjectArtifact>false</useProjectArtifact>
      <outputDirectory>conf</outputDirectory>
      <outputFileNameMapping>${artifact.classifier}.${artifact.extension}</outputFileNameMapping>
      <includes>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-webservices-workspaces:zip:*</include>
      </includes>
    </dependencySet>
    <dependencySet>
      <useProjectArtifact>false</useProjectArtifact>
      <outputDirectory>conf</outputDirectory>
      <outputFileNameMapping>${artifact.artifactId}${dashClassifier?}.${artifact.extension}</outputFileNameMapping>
      <includes>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-database-scripts:*:*</include>
      </includes>
    </dependencySet>
    <dependencySet>
      <useProjectArtifact>false</useProjectArtifact>
      <outputDirectory>test</outputDirectory>
      <outputFileNameMapping>${artifact.artifactId}${dashClassifier?}.${artifact.extension}</outputFileNameMapping>
      <includes>
        <include>de.latlon.xplanbox:xplan-tests-soapui:zip:*</include>
      </includes>
    </dependencySet>
  </dependencySets>
</assembly>
=== db scripts pom ===
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <artifactId>xplan-database-scripts</artifactId>
  <packaging>jar</packaging>
  <description>Liquibase Changelogs zum Aufsetzen/Aktualisieren der Datenhaltung.</description>

  <parent>
    <groupId>de.latlon.xplanbox</groupId>
    <artifactId>xplan-database</artifactId>
    <version>9.4-SNAPSHOT</version>
  </parent>

  <properties>
    <xplan.srid>25832</xplan.srid>
    <xplan.db.user>xplanbox-app-user</xplan.db.user>
  </properties>

  <build>
    <resources>
      <resource>
        <directory>src/main/resources</directory>
        <filtering>false</filtering>
        <excludes>
          <exclude>changelog_xplandb.yaml</exclude>
        </excludes>
      </resource>
      <resource>
        <directory>src/main/resources</directory>
        <filtering>true</filtering>
        <includes>
          <include>changelog_xplandb.yaml</include>
        </includes>
      </resource>
    </resources>
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <groupId>org.liquibase</groupId>
          <artifactId>liquibase-maven-plugin</artifactId>
          <version>${liquibase.version}</version>
          <configuration>
            <expressionVariables>
              <xplan.db.user>${xplan.db.user}</xplan.db.user>
              <xplan.srid>${xplan.srid}</xplan.srid>
            </expressionVariables>
          </configuration>
        </plugin>
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>

observation.command: cat /workspace/xplan-distribution/src/main/assembly/assembly.xml; echo "=== db scripts pom ==="; cat /workspace/xplan-database/xplan-database-scripts/pom.xml | head -50
